cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Will you help me tidy the committee cupboard?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. With the records proving we should replace the committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to tidy, not overthrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm asking again, now you can see what we've been storing.

mechanism: A professionally sorts committee records, then explicitly seeks B's renewed support after revealing that tidying means replacing the committee.
confusable: D220 traps approval into commitment; D223 must recruit again after revealing the changed goal.
comparison: Governance records and new election differ from reversing a plan A and B already backed.
seedUse: Keep clear second request; give A specific evidence-sorting method and a concrete renewed role for B.
